answer.content: After two review cycles confirming no verifiable retention rates exist in Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1, the current research question lacks empirical grounding. A bounded revision is required to anchor the inquiry in at least one directly cited, quantified retention metric before any analysis of memory persistence can be considered valid or testable. Without such data, no relationship between observed memory persistence and reported retention rates can be established or evaluated empirically. The next step is to refine the research question to depend solely on explicitly reported, numerical retention values from the source text.
